items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Pat' in the context of the interviewer's own conversation ('Pat and I were talking about...'), and the interviewee does not mention Pat or describe any relationship with him.

ctx.x: See, I buy this business. It's a nice sound.

It sounds wonderful out there. Yeah, great. Oh yeah, Pat and I were talking about, my, you really play some bass. Oh, shit. You really play some bass. Oh, shit. You know. Thanks to him. Well, I was going to ask if you ever played an electric bass or tried one of those new things that look like that.

I got a mic for my bass my sister gave me, I overplays him. You know, when you play those, when you put a mic on your bass, you got to pick it very easy. I overplays it, see. I got a strong wrist and I overplay it. I said if you play, if you hit one of those basses too hard, you don't get nothing. See? You got to touch it very light. You overplay it. I said I had one and I had the boss to fix up the thing for me down there to put my mic on and overplay it. I didn't need it. And I know Stanford didn't work. Oh,…
